part.Name: Description
part.Short: Faceted microlenses seat behind the cornea and bias stochastic outcomes toward the crown of probability.

part.Name: CyberneticsBaseItem
part.BehaviorDescription: Your weapons' percentage-based effects are 2X as likely to occur, including the base chance for critical hits.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Hydraulic struts and braided myomer redistribute strain through the lower limbs until burdens ride lighter on the frame.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Thruster nozzles nest in the boot cavity; on command they shrug gravity aside in a lunge of flame and smoke.

part.Name: CyberneticsBaseItem
part.BehaviorDescription:
You may activate this item to dash for 1 turn.\n
When you move in a direction, you dash up to 20 spaces toward the nearest enemy or obstacle and perform an attack.\n
For every three spaces you dash, you get +2 to hit and +2 to penetration rolls.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Servo-driven catches ride the forearm rails and strip spent cells from their wells.

part.Name: CyberneticsBaseItem
part.BehaviorDescription: Reloading or Swapping energy cells no longer takes a turn.\n(Stacking does nothing.)

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A dendritic processor suspended in cerebrospinal gel tallies ego-flux into spare cycles.

part.Name: CyberneticsBaseItem
part.BehaviorDescription: Gain 10 compute power per Ego modifier.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Waveguides intercept chaotic sensory noise and shear it away before paradox can seed itself in the forebrain.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A half-phase membrane ribbons across the thorax, tucking an harness and plating into folds beside ordinary space.

part.Name: CyberneticsBaseItem
part.BehaviorDescription: You gain an additional Body equipment slot.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Hardened shoulder yokes and wrist recoil sinks couple heavy weapons to the skeleton until each sweep walks out in a disciplined fan.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A subcranial lattice stages ego-pressure into a tight beam, letting doctrinal argument leap the gap between skull and distant chassis.

part.Name: CyberneticsBaseItem
part.BehaviorDescription: Grants an additional ranged version of the Rebuke skill.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Silk-thin filaments clasp the gut wall and arrest a meal's blessing until it is held like a jewel under glass.

part.Name: CyberneticsBaseItem
part.BehaviorDescription: While active, your current meal effect is integrated and no longer expires from hunger or eating. Activating makes you hungry. Toggle off to release integrated effects.\nAllows you to maintain multiple meal effects at once.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Fibrous proprioceptors stud the torso and spine; when a blow cleaves empty air they dump synthetic adrenaline into the motor strip.

part.Name: CyberneticsBaseItem
part.BehaviorDescription: After dodging an attack, you gain +100 Quickness for 1 turn. This effect has a 10 turn cooldown.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Parallel lymph couplings and microports open one more channel for measured chems, shunting each dose past overloaded pathways.

part.Name: CyberneticsBaseItem
part.BehaviorDescription: Allows you to inject one additional tonic without risk of side effects.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Tracer nanites read circulating elixirs and translate their signatures into spring-tension along the musculature.
